# Resize regression fixtures

These files record what the production analysis-plane filter produces — the
integer box (area-average) filter of `docs/Architecture.md` §4. They are
committed so CI can verify the production analysis bytes without FFmpeg
installed or a video fixture generated.

Each case is a pair of files:

- `<name>.in` — the source plane, raw, with a stride larger than its width.
- `<name>.out` — the tight 8-bit analysis plane the filter produced.

`index.txt` describes each case, one line per case:

```text
<name> <format> <src_w> <src_h> <src_stride> <dst_w> <dst_h>
```

The source stride is recorded because the filter is required to honour it;
the destination plane is tight, one byte per sample.

The test that reads these is `crates/wwxds-media/tests/resize_fixtures.rs`.
It drives the production `FrameResizer` and compares its 8-bit analysis plane
against the recorded plane byte for byte.

The `.out` planes are regenerated by the committed generator
`examples/gen_resize_fixtures` whenever the filter changes in a reviewed way;
the `.in` source planes are frozen inputs and are never rewritten. A mismatch
without a committed regeneration means the filter or the resize path changed
the bytes the detector sees: a review event, not a routine update.
